jobs.title: Project Manager - Canada
jobs.description:
When our square shaped burgers made their first sizzle on the scene more than 50 years ago, people knew our approach wasn’t like any other. Same goes for the way we support our employees. Our culture of openness, flexibility, and inclusiveness allows everybody to flourish in their own way. If you’re looking for a career where you can be part of the action as we continue to grow our iconic brand – We got you!

As a Project Manager, you have the opportunity to be a part of our Center of Operational Excellence, driving efficiency and optimization of projects across the business. As a member of the Canadian supply chain team, you will have ownership of a suite of projects and be empowered to implement them to meet QSCC Canada Inc.’s high standards. Your scope of projects may include Wendy’s core menu items, limited time menu offerings, special programs, or promotions as well as issue management. The Project Manager works closely with internal and external partners, creating strategy and ensuring seamless execution of company initiatives, implementing solutions and projects to deliver on our commitment of quality and price for Canadian restaurant operators.

The Wendy’s Company has formed a cooperative (Co-op) to provide supply chain services for all Wendy’s restaurants in North America. Quality Supply Chain Cooperative, Inc. (QSCC) sources and contracts to purchase items and services necessary for the successful operation of a Wendy’s restaurant. The Co-op (QSCC) is a separate corporation with governance oversight from an elected Board of Directors representing all franchisees and The Wendy’s US Company restaurants. QSCC Canada reports to QSCC U.S and are considered Wendy’s Restaurants of Canada employees leased to QSCC - US.

Responsibilities

Lead the daily workflow related to projects and their development using established standards, processes and tools. Maintain compliance with applicable laws, regulations and policies, while pursuing continuous process improvement and best practices.
Serve as a liaison with cross-functional partners, including procurement, distribution & logistics, suppliers and Wendy’s marketing and R&D teams, to ensure that product and program goals are met.
Anticipate and respond to project issues that may impede project delivery. Partner with team members such as QSCC supply chain team, suppliers, and Wendy’s cross-functional partners to coordinate solutions. Escalate as needed to manage budgeted obsolescence and assurance costs.
Lead management of the procurement item lifecycle for “Limited Time Only” SKUs, including listing, pricing, and supplier management, partnering with category (procurement) manager as needed to assure supply for restaurants in Canada.
Monitor project progress, drafting and distributing periodic progress reports for leadership and stakeholders. Leverage virtual and in-person tools, including Microsoft Teams, to communicate information through email and presentations.
Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education:
High School Diploma/GED

Travel:
5%

Pay Range:
CAD 105,000.00 - CAD 184,000.00 Annually

What We Expect From You

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or related field strongly preferred. Certificate(s) in project management and Six Sigma a plus.
5+ years of project or program management experience, ideally in the restaurant or related industry.
Strong interpersonal skills, including influencing, and conflict management
Strong time management skills, including an inherent sense of urgency
Experience working with cross-functional partners to prioritize and make decisions in a fast-paced environment
Knowledge of Microsoft Suite; especially Excel and PowerBI.
Experience with demand planning and allocation strongly preferred
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong analytical skills
Knowledge of project management processes, such as Scrum and Agile
Experience working in the restaurant industry

Expected Work Location (In Office)
: It is expected that you will primarily perform work at the Wendy's Canadian Restaurant Support Center 5515 North Service Rd STE 201 Burlington ON L7L 6G4 Canada or at other location(s) as designated by the Company. You are required to work in the office at least 3 days a week. Changes to work location arrangements are subject to managerial approval and business needs.

jobs.title: Project Manager  - Fixed Term, Rules Update Programme
jobs.description:
Job description:

Project manager - Rules Update Programme

18-month Fixed-Term Contract Role
Wellington-based role
Play a key role in keeping New Zealand’s aviation system safe, efficient, and fit for the future. 

At the Civil Aviation Authority, we don’t just keep New Zealand’s skies safe and secure, we help shape the future of aviation.

About the Role

As a Project Manager
within the Rules Update Programme (RUP), you'll play a critical role in delivering projects that support the modernisation of New Zealand's aviation regulatory framework. Working across multidisciplinary teams, you'll coordinate, plan and deliver complex policy and rulemaking projects that contribute to regulatory modernisation, international alignment, and positive outcomes for the aviation sector.
Reporting to the Manager, Project Delivery and Portfolio Management, you'll work closely with project leads, subject matter experts, senior stakeholders and programme governance groups to ensure projects are delivered successfully and achieve programme objectives.

Key Responsibilities 

Lead the planning, coordination, delivery and close-out of allocated Rules Update Programme projects.
Develop and maintain project schedules, plans, risks, issues and reporting.
Facilitate planning workshops and support project teams to deliver key milestones.
Engage with managers and stakeholders to secure project resources and subject matter expertise.
Provide guidance and support to project leads and project teams on project processes and delivery requirements.
Monitor project progress, manage risks and issues, and escalate matters where required.
Support stakeholder engagement and communication activities across allocated projects.
Contribute to continuous improvement activities and lessons learned processes across the programme. 

The salary range for this role is $115,536 to $141,751
. Starting salaries are based on knowledge, skills and experience the successful candidate brings to the role, as well as internal relativities. 
For more information on the role please view the position description. 

What You'll Bring 

You'll be an organised and proactive project professional who enjoys working in complex environments and coordinating diverse groups toward a common outcome. You'll be confident managing priorities, building relationships and keeping projects on track while adapting to changing requirements.

To succeed in this role you'll demonstrate: 
At least three years' experience in project management within a complex and changing operating environments.
Strong planning and organisational skills, including experience developing project schedules and plans.
Experience leading project workstreams or coordinating project teams to deliver results.
Excellent stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
Experience monitoring project progress, managing risks and resolving issues.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence using project management methodologies, tools and techniques.
Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Planner, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience in the aviation sector is preferred, but not essential. 

About Us 

The Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) is New Zealand’s aviation safety and security regulator. We play a critical role in protecting the travelling public, supporting the aviation sector, and strengthening New Zealand’s international reputation. 
Our vision is simple and powerful: A safe and secure aviation system – so people are safe, and feel safe when they fly. 
Our values -  Professionalism, Respect, Integrity, Transparency, and Collaboration
 - guide everything we do. We’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and supportive environment where everyone feels respected, safe, and valued. Our people are central to our success. 

Why Join Us? 

5 weeks annual leave.
10 days sick leave, available after 6-months of continuous employment. 

Matching KiwiSaver contributions up to 4% 

Flu vaccinations 

Employee Assistance Programme 

Ready to Apply? 

This is a rare opportunity to contribute to one of the CAA’s most significant regulatory programmes of work. If you're passionate about policy, regulation, and helping create a safer, future-ready aviation system for New Zealand, we'd love to hear from you. This role is offered as an 18-month fixed term contract. 

Apply directly by completing the online application form and submitting your CV and cover letter. Your cover letter will be a key part of our assessment process, so please highlight how your experience aligns with the requirements of this role. 

We want to ensure accessibility needs are well supported, so the recruitment process is fair and equitable for all. Please let us know if there is any support we can provide to ensure the recruitment process is fully accessible to you. 

For more information, please view the position description. If you have any questions about the role or application process, contact the Recruitment team at recruitment@caa.govt.nz. 

Applications close: Tuesday, 15 September 2026 

Please be aware that we may start shortlisting as applications come in. We encourage early applications, as the advertisement may close sooner than stated.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead a large interior fit out project or a larger program consisting of individual, multi-disciplined commercial real estate project solutions for our Financial Services Sector clients, with direct accountability for project delivery.

This is not a remote role and does require availability to work on site in New York from the client offices a minimum of three days per week.

What you’ll do

Manage all facets of project management (budget, schedule, procurement, quality & risk) for individual real estate projects including planning, design, construction, occupancy and closeout.
Interface directly with clients to define project requirements. Prepares scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimate & budget, cash flow, work plan schedule & milestones, quality control, and risk identification.
Identify project delivery resources from pre-qualified lists or through individual project qualification process; conducts standard to sophisticated request for proposals; completes bid analysis; leads evaluation interviews, recommends resources to clients.
Implement communication plans for meetings, written reports and meeting minutes to ensure client and project resources are advised in real time. Implement project documentation governance aligned with company and client requirements. Ensure project data integrity and documentation is accurate, timely and coordinated. Facilitates project meetings.
Supervise progress of each project against goals, objectives, approved budgets, approved timelines. Reports status and variances. Crafts action plans to meet objectives, budget and schedule.
Implement change management routines to assess change requests, make recommendations, secure client approvals, and issue change orders. Assesses change requests to resolve impacts to scope, budget, schedule, quality and risk.
Demonstrate ability to identify project risks, develop risk mitigation and contingency plans, and implement action plans to reduce or eliminate project risks.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
BS Degree and at least 6 years of related experience and or training is required
Knowledge of industry trends, project management and construction procedures and best practices
Ability to work in a fast paced, demanding environment while managing multiple projects and / or programs in varying stages. Class "A" Financial or Professional Services Sector experience is helpful.
Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), must be able to complete all administrative tasks associated with the role.
Ability to work under pressure, meet close deadlines and be on site regularly during project duration and have flexibility to work non-traditional hours at times.
Ability to analyze sophisticated information organize and prioritize work while meeting multiple deadlines and develop plans to address identified issues.
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to self-manage, with strong initiative, is critical to prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously in a robust environment.

Additional Information

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
Description

The Americas DSP organization partners with entrepreneurial individuals who manage their own delivery businesses (DSPs) across the US, Canada, Brazil, and Mexico. Together, we build sustainable and scalable delivery capacity so that Amazon can continue to delight customers with fast, efficient, and bar raising fulfillment of their orders. Our North Star goal is to improve DSP Quality and help them scale their business. Quality partners operate safely and reliably, meet performance standards, take a long-term view of their business relationship with Amazon as they engage with the program, adhere to program policies, and manage healthy businesses. Within the Americas DSP organization, the DSP Shared Services team drives scalable solutions for our DSP and internal partners. We standardize complex tasks for a team of Account Managers to execute with quality.

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead and drive learning and development programs that support both Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Business Coaches (BCs) within Amazon's Last Mile organization. This role sits at the intersection of program management, instructional strategy, and operational excellence — ensuring that DSPs and BCs have the knowledge, tools, and resources they need to deliver world-class performance. This role will also help define new workflows for our Account Management team, with a North Star of centralizing operational support for DSP owners.

Key job responsibilities

Program Strategy & Roadmap: Own the end-to-end learning program strategy for DSP and BC audiences, aligning with organizational goals around safety, quality, compliance, and operational performance
Curriculum Development & Governance: Partner with subject matter experts, instructional designers, and operations leaders to develop, maintain, and continuously improve learning content for DSP owners, drivers, and Business Coaches
Account Management Role Standardization: Define and codify the Business Coach and DSS Account Manager role — including standard operating procedures, expectations, competency frameworks, and performance benchmarks — to ensure consistency and clarity across all regions
Stakeholder Management: Serve as the central point of contact across cross-functional teams (Operations, Safety, Fleet, Compliance, Technology) to identify learning needs, prioritize initiatives, and drive alignment
Program Execution: Define project plans, manage timelines, remove blockers, and deliver programs on time and at scale across multiple regions
Metrics & Impact Measurement: Establish KPIs and success metrics for learning programs; use data to measure effectiveness, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement
Change Management: Lead change management efforts for new program launches, policy updates, and process changes that impact DSP and BC populations
Scalability & Innovation: Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and new delivery modalities (e.g., eLearning, microlearning, just-in-time resources) to scale learning programs efficiently

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent

jobs.description:
Title

Program Manager (Contingency)

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

Program Summary

KBR’s Exploration & Logistics (E&L) business unit delivers mission-critical solutions supporting global defense, federal civilian, logistics, engineering, and space exploration missions. E&L provides integrated capabilities across logistics and sustainment, mission operations, engineering services, readiness and modernization programs, scientific research support, and exploration initiatives in some of the world’s most complex and challenging environments.

The business unit supports customers across the Department of Defense, federal civilian agencies, and commercial partners, delivering innovative solutions that enhance mission readiness, operational effectiveness, and long-term mission success.

Job Summary

The Program Manager (PM) serves as the single point of accountability and primary interface between KBR and the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) for all contract performance under the Public Assistance Technical Assistance Contract (PA TAC VI). The PM provides executive leadership, strategic direction, operational oversight, and quality management to ensure the successful delivery of technical, programmatic, and administrative support services in support of FEMA's Public Assistance Program and disaster recovery mission.

The PM is responsible for planning, organizing, directing, coordinating, and controlling all contract activities, resources, personnel, subcontractors, and deliverables while ensuring compliance with contract requirements, FEMA policies, federal regulations, and applicable performance standards. The PM leads a geographically dispersed workforce capable of supporting multiple concurrent disasters nationwide and ensures rapid mobilization, scalable operations, and continuous mission readiness. This position requires the ability to support nationwide disaster operations, including periodic travel and availability during emergency activation periods. In addition, Direct day-to-day contract execution across all task orders and disaster assignments and managing nationwide surge operations and disaster deployment activities which includes: coordinating staffing, resource allocation, and workload balancing to support multiple simultaneous disaster operations. While ensuring timely mobilization, deployment, tracking, and demobilization of personnel, the PM must have sound PM skills and capabilities demonstrated by supporting other FEMA programs or similar complex programs.

The PM will ensure contract performance meets or exceeds all performance metrics, service level requirements, and quality standards and leads program governance activities, including executive reviews, performance assessments, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives. While maintaining responsibility for overall contract cost, schedule, and performance.

Please Note:
This role is contingent upon final project approval and contract funding.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership
Federal Program Management
FEMA Public Assistance Expertise
Disaster Recovery Operations
Stakeholder Management
Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement
Risk Management
Resource Planning and Workforce Management
Financial and Contract Management
Executive Communication
Problem Solving and Decision Making
Mission-Focused Service Delivery

The Program Manager Shall Demonstrate

Comprehensive knowledge of FEMA Public Assistance Program delivery, grant management, and disaster recovery operations.
Experience applying Stafford Act authorities, 2 CFR Part 200, FEMA Public Assistance Program and Policy Guide (PAPPG), and applicable federal regulations.
Experience managing large-scale disaster recovery operations involving multiple simultaneous federally declared disasters.
Training and experience in Incident Command System (ICS) principles and emergency management operations.
Experience overseeing geographically dispersed teams supporting field, regional, and headquarters operations.
Familiarity with FEMA's recovery mission, state and local government coordination, and stakeholder engagement processes.

This role requires an experienced, forward-leaning leader capable of operating in austere, rapidly changing environments while maintaining strict compliance with contractual, safety, and quality standards. The PM will enforce KBR’s Zero Harm culture and ensure all operations are executed in accordance with company policies, applicable regulations, and customer requirements

Roles And Responsibilities

Lead the contract and task orders with day-to-day execution of program operations, ensuring sustainment goals, strategic objectives, financial goals, and customer expectations are met or exceeded.
Liaison between key stakeholders to ensure efficient delivery and proactive risk management.
Plan and support execution of End-Use Monitoring (EUM) activities, including in-person, secondary, and virtual monitoring inspections in Ukraine.
Design and implement monitoring tools and program surveys, including sampling plans, tool development, and digital data collection methods.
Lead field supervision efforts to generate high-quality evidence on program performance and outcomes.
Oversee data cleaning, validation, and analysis to ensure structure, accuracy, integrity, and readiness for internal decision-making and external reporting.
Prepare clear, funder-ready analytical reports and professional data visualizations that translate complex findings into actionable insights and demonstrate results against agreed indicators and targets.
Oversee and manage a team of contractor personnel technically proficient in monitoring and evaluation activities and possess the requisite property management and related experience necessary for EUM.
Maintain accurate documentation and reporting processes, including Excel-based tracking, inventory support (as applicable), and compliance-ready program records.

Highly Desired

FEMA National Incident Management System (NIMS) training:
IS-100: Introduction to Incident Command System (ICS)
IS-200: Basic Incident Command System for Initial Response
IS-700: National Incident Management System, An Introduction
IS-800: National Response Framework, An Introduction

FEMA-approved cybersecurity and information security awareness training as required for access to FEMA systems and data.
FEMA records management, privacy, and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) training as required under contract requirements.

Preferred Certifications

The following certifications are highly desirable:

Program Management Professional (PMP)
Certified Emergency Manager (CEM)
Associate Emergency Manager (AEM)
FEMA Professional Development Series (PDS)
FEMA Advanced Professional Series (APS)
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
Certified Construction Manager (CCM)
Professional Engineer (PE)
Certified Floodplain Manager (CFM)
PMI Risk Management Professional (PMI-RMP)

Continuing Education Requirements

The Program Manager shall maintain professional certifications and complete all FEMA-required training throughout the life of the contract. The Program Manager is expected to participate in periodic FEMA updates, policy implementation training, readiness exercises, and disaster workforce development activities to ensure continued proficiency in Public Assistance delivery and disaster recovery operations.

Basic Qualifications

Must have a minimum of a bachelor’s degree in business or a related technical field such as program assessment and technical assistance on FEMA programs
Must also have a minimum of 15 years of experience performing program management functions. This experience must include previous experience as a Program Manager on multiple projects of comparable magnitude and complexity of this contract.
Should have disaster operational experience
Should have Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
Must have high-level management and leadership skills
Ability to both lead and function as a member of a team.
Should have excellent written and oral communication skills
Must have attention to detail, great organizational skills, as well as the ability to multi-task and work well under pressure.
Must have conflict resolution and problem-solving skills to include risk management
Must have cost control and budgeting skills
Must have teamwork and motivational skills
Bachelor’s degree in Program Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Expertise in KPI reporting, risk management integration, and formal change control processes
Strong understanding of FEMA technical assistance programs and requires rules, regulations, standards, and training
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and customers.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and rapidly changing requirements.
Ability to maintain high standards of compliance, safety, and quality in dynamic environments.
U.S. citizenship.
Ability to deploy and operate in remote or austere locations.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelors degree, a Master’s degree is preferred
PMP
Experience managing subcontractors and local vendor networks in remote locations.
Knowledge of FEMA Program assistance frameworks, and quality management systems.
Strong proficiency in reporting tools, Excel-based tracking, and program performance dashboards.

KBR Benefits

KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

jobs.description:
Description

The Senior Operations Program Manager (OPM) is responsible for aligning all resources needed to support assigned programs at the DFW11 facility in Dallas, TX from Postponement Approval through End of Life. The OPM coordinates planning, material management, site technical, and Contract Manufacturer (CM) resources to deliver factory readiness, production launch, and sustained operations on time and on budget. The OPM partners with Site Technical Managers and Sunnyvale Product Managers to plan new product introductions, and drives cross-functional execution with Engineering, Quality, Automation, and the CM across every phase of the program lifecycle.

Key job responsibilities

Own all aspects of factory readiness from project kick-off through production launch and sustained operations.
Represent DPO to the Operations and Supply Chain Organization for each assigned program.
Create and manage detailed program schedules to drive readiness for all site build-out, fit-up, and factory deliverables.
Manage, track, report, and forecast all costs for site build-out, fit-up, and factory deliverables.
Identify and escalate risks in manufacturing process development, equipment delivery, quality control plans, and validation schedules.
Oversee the Contract Manufacturer's coordination of contractors and suppliers for installation and maintenance of power and data infrastructure, compressed air services, and other site equipment.
Lead or participate in daily standup meetings during program launches, control runs, and line installations.
Drive operational improvements using Lean and 6σ practices.
Report on program metrics and goals on a monthly basis to all levels of the organization.
Travel as needed to accomplish business needs.
Drive the Contract Manufacturer (CM) to meet production, quality, cost, and schedule targets through regular performance reviews, metric tracking, and escalation when goals are at risk.
Own Engineering Change Order (ECO) management for assigned programs, including receiving change notifications, assessing factory impact, ensuring production compliance, and informing the Materials Manager and Sr. Planner of BOM, process, and schedule implications.

A day in the life

The OPM is actively engaged in aligning resources and driving program execution at DFW11 across every stage from Postponement Approval through End of Life. On any given day, the OPM may be working with STMs and Sunnyvale Product Managers to plan capacity, material, and technology requirements for a new product introduction, defining manufacturing strategies and site readiness requirements for a project launch, or leading the daily standup during a production ramp to drive issue resolution and report progress against yield targets. During sustained operations, the OPM focuses on operational improvements and CM performance management. The OPM may also be presenting schedule or operational risks in an executive review, on the production floor with the Contract Manufacturer reviewing line performance, or finding creative solutions to complex program problems.

About The Team

Devices Postponement Operations (DPO) is Amazon Lab126's team responsible for in-region postponement, customization, and pack-out of Amazon's innovative devices. We finalize the assembly of devices using automated assembly and pack-out lines so that Amazon can customize products to meet just-in-time demand. We enable Amazon to deliver the right configuration of a product at low cost and high quality.

Amazon's Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Lab126 has produced incredible devices like Fire TV, the Echo family of products, and Astro. We deliver delightfully unique Amazon experiences, giving customers instant access to everything digital or physical.

Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
Can show strong verbal and written communication skills
Experience working with distributed teams
5+ years of high volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments experience

Proven track record of managing complex programs with previous experience supporting the introduction of new products in a manufacturing or pack-out environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing or implementing integrated automation solutions such as material handling systems, high-speed packaging lines, or manufacturing lines
5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience, or experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high-speed manufacturing
Experience presenting complex ideas in writing in the form of authoring white papers, proposals, or other formal strategy documents
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or experience in project management
Experience writing and publishing technical documents or equivalent

Our client is seeking a Data Analyst to play a critical role in improving the quality, reliability, and scalability of their data ecosystem. This position focuses on identifying and resolving data inconsistencies, analyzing complex datasets, and building a more reliable data foundation across operational systems.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, naturally curious, and investigative in their approach—someone who goes beyond running queries and actively diagnoses underlying data issues, identifies root causes, develops solutions, and clearly documents findings and recommendations.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Workplace Health & Safety – Contractor Safety
jobs.description:
Description

Passionate about Safety? Join our dynamic team as a Senior Contractor Safety Program Manager and make a real impact on the North America operations that power the world's largest e-commerce company!

In this exciting role, you'll be a key partner to Procurement, Field Workplace, Health, and Safety (WHS), and site support teams such as Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering (RME), working closely with them to ensure world-class safety standards for our under the roof contractors across Amazon North America Operations. You will also liaison externally with Amazon's contractor qualification partner, Avetta, supporting product enhancements and contractor partnership.

You will be empowered to own and drive safety programs from inception through implementation.

You will also own safety related projects and own the actions needed to deliver them.

Also supporting field operations daily safety routines, you will support rigorous investigations to uncover root causes, develop actions, and share learnings.

Collaborating cross-functionally, you'll scale successful safety initiatives and improvement projects, cementing Amazon's reputation as an industry leader. If you're a motivated safety professional committed to continuous improvement, this is an unparalleled opportunity to make your mark.

Bring your safety expertise and collaborative mindset - together, we'll reinvent what's possible! Apply now.

Key job responsibilities

A successful candidate will be able to own and drive safety programs from inception through implementation.

The candidate will own safety related projects and own the actions needed to deliver them including narrative paper writing for executive leadership audiences.

Ability to assess contractor high risk operations, such as work at heights, hazardous energy, and lifting and rigging and implement strategies to minimize risk.

Serve as a trusted safety partner to senior regional leaders across North America, aligning on strategic priorities and tracking progress against goals.

Conduct regular site visits to Amazon warehouse locations to personally observe safety practices, gather feedback from frontline teams, and identify opportunities for improvement.

Utilize insights from site visits to develop and update safety standards, protocols, and training materials that drive consistent, best-in-class safety performance.

Lead comprehensive incident investigations, rapidly identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

Collaborate cross-functionally with teams in Operations, Procurement, Construction, and beyond to scale successful safety initiatives and embed sustainable improvements.

Monitor safety metrics, analyze trends, and present recommendations to senior leadership on priorities and investment areas.

A day in the life

You might start with a series of check-in calls, connecting with Procurement and Regional Site WHS leaders across North America to discuss emerging issues, share best practices, and align on priorities. Then, you hop on a global project call, collaborating with teammates from around the world to finalize a new digital safety tool. In the afternoon, you analyze leading indicator data, identifying an opportunity for improvement.

About The Team

The North America WHS Contractor Safety team collaborates cross-functionally to develop and improve contractor safety policies, procedures, and standards. We provide SME knowledge and support for contractor safety management, deep dive performance through Avetta, and track incident data for risk-based decisions. We standardize contractor project safety documentation and under-the-roof contractor management through Avetta Worksite Safety. We drive standardized contractor competence by collecting and training records and experience via Avetta Worker Management. We ensure contractors adhere to Amazon safety requirements through orientation and acknowledgement of Special Safety Conditions.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of program or project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Overview:

If you're looking for the stability of a profitable, growing company with the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup, we’re hiring. SageSure, a leader in catastrophe-exposed property insurance, is seeking an Program Analyst. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions by supporting the analysis, documentation, and continuous improvement of insurance products, processes, and systems. As a key member of the dedicated Commercial team, you'll partner with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Operations to gather requirements, document business processes, validate solutions, and support strategic initiatives. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams, improving processes, and helping deliver high-quality solutions that support business growth and operational excellence.

What you’d be doing:

Partner with business, product, engineering, and operational stakeholders to gather, analyze, document, and validate business and technical requirements.
Develop and maintain clear, accurate, and comprehensive requirements documentation, process flows, user stories, and supporting artifacts.
Collaborate with engineering and solution design teams to ensure requirements are well-defined, understood, and aligned with business objectives.
Review and validate requirements with stakeholders, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment across impacted teams.
Coordinate with Quality Assurance teams to support testing efforts and ensure delivered solutions meet documented business requirements.
Analyze existing systems, processes, and workflows to identify opportunities for improvement, increased efficiency, and enhanced user experiences.
Support the documentation and refinement of business processes, operational procedures, and system capabilities.
Build strong working relationships through a combination of virtual collaboration, office visits, stakeholder meetings, workshops, and in-person working sessions.
Facilitate discussions and working sessions with stakeholders across multiple functions, locations, and time zones.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements management, documentation standards, and business analysis practices.
Support implementation activities, issue resolution, and post-launch follow-up as needed.
Participate in special projects and strategic initiatives that support organizational priorities.

We’re looking for someone who has:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, preferably in Business, Insurance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
1–3 years of Property & Casualty insurance experience, preferably within Commercial Insurance.
Experience gathering, documenting, analyzing, and validating business requirements.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into clear, actionable requirements.
Experience working with cross-functional teams in a collaborative environment.
Familiarity with insurance policy administration, sales, servicing, or operational workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other business productivity tools.
Ability to work effectively in a hybrid and geographically distributed environment, leveraging both virtual and in-person collaboration.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners located across multiple offices and time zones.
Ability and willingness to travel periodically for team meetings, stakeholder engagement, office visits, offsites, and company events (approximately 10–15% annually).

Highly preferred candidates also have:

Experience working with Smartsheet, Confluence, Jira, or similar project and requirements management tools.
Experience reverse engineering business processes, system functionality, or requirements documentation.
Familiarity with XML, JSON, SQL, or other technical concepts used in software development environments.
Experience working within Agile development teams and methodologies.
Experience supporting insurance product implementations, enhancements, or operational transformation initiatives.

At SageSure, our Commercial team is helping shape the future of one of the company's most important growth areas. We're bringing together talented professionals across product management, engineering, operations, data, and business functions to build innovative solutions, streamline processes, and create scalable capabilities that support long-term success. Named among the Best Places to Work in Insurance by Business Insurance for four years in a row (2020-2023), SageSure is one of the largest managing general underwriters (MGU) focused on catastrophe-exposed property in the US. Since its founding in 2009, SageSure has experienced exceptional growth while generating underwriting profits for carrier partners through hurricanes, wildfires, and hail. to lead AI adoption initiatives, Agile transformation programs, and enterprise-wide enablement efforts. This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please
.

jobs.description:
Title

Deputy Program Manager (Contingency)

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

Program Summary

KBR’s Exploration & Logistics (E&L) business unit delivers mission-critical solutions supporting global defense, federal civilian, logistics, engineering, and space exploration missions. E&L provides integrated capabilities across logistics and sustainment, mission operations, engineering services, readiness and modernization programs, scientific research support, and exploration initiatives in some of the world’s most complex and challenging environments.

The business unit supports customers across the Department of Defense, federal civilian agencies, and commercial partners, delivering innovative solutions that enhance mission readiness, operational effectiveness, and long-term mission success.

Job Summary

The Deputy Program Manager (DPM) serves as the principal deputy to the Program Manager and provides direct support in the execution, oversight, and management of all contract performance under the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Public Assistance Technical Assistance Contract (PA TAC VI). The DPM assists in providing leadership, operational direction, quality management, and administrative oversight to ensure the successful delivery of technical, programmatic, and administrative support services in support of FEMA's Public Assistance Program and disaster recovery mission.

The DPM supports the planning, organization, coordination, and execution of all contract activities, resources, personnel, subcontractors, and deliverables while ensuring compliance with contract requirements, FEMA policies, federal regulations, and applicable performance standards. The DPM helps manage a geographically dispersed workforce supporting multiple concurrent disasters nationwide and contributes to rapid mobilization, scalable operations, and continuous mission readiness.

The DPM serves as the designated alternate to the Program Manager and assumes responsibility for program operations during the Program Manager's absence. This position requires the ability to support nationwide disaster operations, including periodic travel and availability during emergency activation periods.

The DPM assists with day-to-day contract execution across all task orders and disaster assignments, supporting nationwide surge operations and disaster deployment activities. Responsibilities include coordinating staffing, resource allocation, deployment readiness, and workload balancing to support multiple simultaneous disaster operations. The DPM ensures timely mobilization, deployment, tracking, and demobilization of personnel and must possess demonstrated experience supporting FEMA programs or similarly complex federal programs.

The DPM supports the Program Manager in ensuring contract performance meets or exceeds all performance metrics, service level requirements, and quality standards. The DPM contributes to program governance activities, including performance assessments, risk management, quality reviews, corrective action implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives while supporting overall cost, schedule, and performance objectives.

This role requires an experienced, adaptable leader capable of operating in austere and rapidly changing environments while maintaining strict compliance with contractual, safety, and quality standards. The DPM will promote KBR's Zero Harm culture and ensure operations are executed in accordance with company policies, applicable regulations, and customer requirements.

Please Note:
This role is contingent upon final project approval and contract funding.

Core Competencies

Program Leadership and Team Management
Federal Program and Project Management
FEMA Public Assistance Expertise
Disaster Recovery Operations
Stakeholder Engagement
Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement
Risk Management
Workforce Planning and Resource Coordination
Contract Administration
Financial and Schedule Management
Strategic Communications
Problem Solving and Decision Making
Mission-Focused Service Delivery

The Deputy Program Manager Shall Demonstrate

Comprehensive knowledge of FEMA Public Assistance Program delivery, grant management, and disaster recovery operations.
Experience applying Stafford Act authorities, 2 CFR Part 200, FEMA Public Assistance Program and Policy Guide (PAPPG), and applicable federal regulations.
Experience supporting large-scale disaster recovery operations involving multiple simultaneous federally declared disasters.
Training and experience in Incident Command System (ICS) principles and emergency management operations.
Experience overseeing geographically dispersed teams supporting field, regional, and headquarters operations.
Familiarity with FEMA's recovery mission, state, local, tribal, and territorial coordination processes, and stakeholder engagement practices.
Demonstrated ability to support program management functions including workforce management, deployment operations, risk mitigation, and performance monitoring.

Roles And Responsibilities

Serve as the primary deputy to the Program Manager and act on behalf of the Program Manager when designated.
Support day-to-day execution of the contract and associated task orders, ensuring strategic objectives, performance goals, financial targets, and customer expectations are achieved.
Coordinate with FEMA leadership, Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), task order managers, subcontractors, and stakeholders to facilitate successful contract performance.
Monitor operational performance, identify risks and issues, and implement corrective actions to maintain program effectiveness.
Support surge staffing activities, including workforce planning, deployment coordination, personnel tracking, and resource allocation.
Assist in managing geographically dispersed personnel and ensuring adequate staffing levels across disaster operations.
Lead or support program reviews, readiness assessments, executive briefings, and performance monitoring activities.
Support implementation of quality management processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
Assist in managing program schedules, budgets, deliverables, subcontractor performance, and contract compliance requirements.
Prepare reports, metrics, dashboards, and executive-level briefings regarding program status, performance, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Ensure compliance with FEMA guidance, contractual requirements, federal regulations, cybersecurity requirements, records management policies, and privacy standards.
Maintain close coordination with program leadership to ensure continuity of operations across all contract activities.
Support customer engagement efforts and maintain positive working relationships with FEMA and other key stakeholders.
Promote employee development, safety awareness, teamwork, and operational excellence throughout the program.

Highly Desired Training

FEMA National Incident Management System (NIMS)

IS-100: Introduction to Incident Command System (ICS)
IS-200: Basic Incident Command System for Initial Response
IS-700: National Incident Management System, An Introduction
IS-800: National Response Framework, An Introduction

IS-1000: Public Assistance Program Eligibility
IS-1001: Public Assistance Project Formulation
IS-1002: Public Assistance Damage Assessment and Cost Estimating

FEMA privacy and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection training

Annual FEMA-mandated refresher training

Preferred Certifications

Project Management Professional (PMP)

Continuing Education Requirements

jobs.description:
SOVOS

Enterprise Project Manager

Managed & Professional Services·Full-Time·UK/AMS/ESP

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're transforming how global enterprises navigate regulatory complexity. We're looking for an Enterprise Project Manager to join our European Professional Services team, with the ability to be based in the United Kingdom, Netherlands, or Spain. This is a senior delivery role for an experienced PM who understands the complexity of enterprise SaaS implementations and brings deep familiarity with tax compliance, e-invoicing, or regulatory technology. You'll own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-country implementations for enterprise clients across EMEA, operating with a high degree of autonomy and directly impacting client satisfaction and the reputation of Sovos Professional Services in Europe.

More Specifically, You Will

Own end-to-end project delivery for enterprise e-invoicing and tax compliance implementations across multiple EMEA countries simultaneously.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for client stakeholders, from project teams to C-suite sponsors, throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, risk registers, issue logs, and status reports; proactively surface risks and drive resolution before they become escalations.
Lead structured project governance, including weekly status meetings, monthly steering committee sessions, and go/no-go decision processes, in alignment with Sovos delivery methodology.
Manage project scope rigorously; identify, document, and drive change orders when client requests exceed agreed SOW boundaries.
Coordinate cross-functional Sovos resources (Solution Consultants, Technical Consultants, SAP specialists, Regulatory, and Product teams) to deliver against project commitments.
Track and report project hours against PS retainer balances; proactively communicate burn-down status and initiate retainer expansion conversations at appropriate thresholds.
Leverage AI-assisted project management tools to improve delivery efficiency, automate status reporting, and surface risk patterns across the client portfolio.
Manage Hypercare periods post-go-live and execute formal project handover to Sovos Customer Support.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of PS delivery methodology, SOW templates, onboarding playbooks, and project governance frameworks.

What You Bring to Sovos

You've built solid experience delivering enterprise SaaS implementations in a client-facing Professional Services environment, with demonstrated expertise managing complex, multi-stakeholder implementations in the tax compliance, e-invoicing, VAT, or regulatory technology space.
Demonstrated success managing projects with enterprise clients (500M+ revenue) across multiple countries and time zones concurrently.
Experience with SAP-integrated implementations (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or Process Orchestration) is strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience with retainer-based PS engagements, including scope management, change order discipline, and hour burn-down governance.
Familiarity with EMEA e-invoicing mandates, including France (PPF/PDP), Germany (XRechnung/Peppol), Poland (KSeF), and/or Turkey (e-Fatura/e-Arşiv), is a significant advantage.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills: able to build trust with client executives and navigate competing priorities without losing delivery momentum.
Solid commercial acumen: you understand the relationship between project delivery, revenue recognition, and margin, and manage accordingly.
Proactive risk management mindset: you identify and escalate issues early, document decisions, and drive accountability without being asked.
Clear, structured communicator (written and verbal) capable of adapting tone and detail level for technical teams, client project managers, and executive sponsors alike.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in fast-moving, multi-mandate environments where priorities can shift quickly.
Proficiency with project management tooling (e.g. Cloud Coach, Salesforce, Jira, or equivalent PSA/CRM platforms); comfort with AI-assisted workflows to enhance delivery speed and insight generation is a plus.
Demonstrated project management capability through certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or equivalent proven delivery experience is valued.
Equivalent experience to a Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
Fluency in English required; proficiency in French, German, Dutch, Spanish, or Polish is a meaningful advantage given the client base.
Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

Company Background

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. jobs.description:
Referment is working with a fast-growing technology company providing software to charities, community organisations and public sector customers.

They're looking for a Customer Implementation Manager to take ownership of new client onboarding and help customers successfully adopt the platform.

This is a hands-on role combining implementation, customer success, project management and process improvement. You'll work with multiple customers simultaneously, taking them from initial kick-off through to successful launch and ongoing adoption.

The customer base is varied and often non-technical, so the ability to understand problems, explain technology simply and build strong relationships is just as important as traditional SaaS experience.

The Role

Customer Onboarding & Implementation

Owning customer implementations from kick-off through to go-live.
Managing multiple concurrent client projects and priorities.
Breaking complex implementations into clear, manageable phases.
Setting timelines and managing customer expectations.
Understanding how customers currently operate and helping them translate their requirements into effective use of the platform.
Training users with varying levels of technical confidence.
Helping customers adopt new functionality and get increasing value from the product.
Identifying issues that genuinely affect implementation and prioritising them appropriately.
Supporting data migrations and other technical aspects of onboarding.
Visiting customers where required to understand how they work in practice.

Customer Operations & Process Improvement

Improve and standardise the customer onboarding process as the company grows.
Build documentation, guides and repeatable processes.
Help manage customer support and resolve issues.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work.
Track customer feedback and feature requests.
Work closely with the product and engineering teams to communicate customer priorities.
Identify patterns across customer feedback and turn them into useful product insights.
Help develop scalable customer success processes as the customer base expands.

What We're Looking For

You could already be working within Customer Success, Implementation, Onboarding or Professional Services, but we're equally interested in people who have developed the right skills elsewhere.

Relevant Backgrounds Could Include

Customer implementation or onboarding.
Customer success.
Project or programme management.
Consulting

What's more important is that you can demonstrate:

Excellent customer communication and relationship-building skills.
The ability to manage several projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
Confidence working with customers who aren't particularly technical.
The ability to teach people how to use new systems clearly and patiently.
Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to challenge a customer's proposed solution when necessary.
A structured approach to project delivery.
The ability to turn recurring work into documented and scalable processes.
Good judgement around prioritisation and urgency.
Comfort working within a fast-moving and changing environment

Experience working with charities, community organisations or the public sector would be particularly valuable.

Technical experience, especially around data migrations, SaaS platforms, customer data or integrations, would also be useful but isn't essential.

This could suit a Customer Success Manager, Implementation Manager, Customer Onboarding Manager, Implementation Consultant or Project Manager, as well as someone looking to move into technology from another client-facing environment.

jobs.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

People Operations is taking on more complex, cross-functional program work as Harvey grows globally — from opening new entities and markets, to integrating acquisitions, to evolving the systems and providers that support our employees around the world. These programs span People, Finance, Legal, Tax, IT, and other teams, and need a dedicated owner who can bring the whole thing together.

You’ll run point on these initiatives end-to-end: defining requirements, building the plan, driving decisions and execution across teams, and making sure we’re ready to go live. This is a hands-on program management role — you’ll work closely with functional experts, but you’re expected to get into the substance, develop a point of view, and personally execute work wherever needed to drive the program forward.

What You'll Do

Own complex global programs from scope through go-live and handoff, including new entity formation and geographic expansion, M&A integrations, and the ongoing evolution of our infrastructure in existing markets — such as EOR and vendor transitions, payroll migrations, and other major operational changes.
Build and drive the program plan, translating a messy objective into clear requirements, workstreams, owners, dependencies, readiness gates, and decisions; proactively surface risks, resolve blockers, and adjust the plan as facts change.
Connect the dots across functions. Partner deeply with People Ops, People Systems, Finance, Payroll, Legal, Tax, IT, and other teams to understand how decisions in one workstream affect another and make sure nothing falls between the cracks.
Own program communication and change management, from crisp executive updates and decision points to clear, thoughtful communications for employees affected by a change.
Build repeatable infrastructure as we scale, turning what we learn from each program into better templates, SOPs, playbooks, and operating processes for the next one.
Keep the employee experience at the center. Make sure operational complexity behind the scenes translates into a coordinated, thoughtful experience for employees — particularly during high-change moments like entering a new market, transitioning employment infrastructure, or integrating an acquired team.

What You Have

7+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs, with experience in global People infrastructure such as geographic expansion, entity formation, M&A integration, or related work.
A hands-on operating style and strong bias toward action. You dig into the substance, step into gaps, and do what’s needed to keep complex work moving. You’re comfortable figuring things out as you go and have good judgment about what requires deeper diligence versus what simply needs to get done.
Strong stakeholder management and judgment, with the ability to align specialists and senior leaders across functions without formal authority.
Clear, direct executive communication. You can distill a complicated program into the decisions, risks, and tradeoffs that matter and communicate them appropriately to everyone from executives to affected employees.
Strong AI fluency. You use AI as a core part of how you work — to move faster, synthesize information, work through ambiguity, and increase the quality and leverage of your output.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is a Vertical AI company built for the utility industry, delivering appliance-level intelligence for every customer, grid asset, and hour of the year through our UtilityAI™ Platform. We're accelerating a clean energy future by giving utilities and their customers the ability to make smarter, data-driven energy decisions.

Bidgely's platform is connected to 38M+ meters across 45+ utility deployments and is backed by over 20 patents. Our approach combines patented disaggregation science, generative AI for natural-language insight, and agentic AI for autonomous operations — giving utilities a level of individual-customer intelligence and grid insights that horizontal AI and legacy analytics platforms can't match.

Bidgely has been named #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company's list of Most Innovative Companies in the World and recognized as a Utility Analytics Leader by Guidehouse.

What We Do

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI™ Platform transforms multiple dimensions of utility data — such as energy consumption, demographics, and customer interactions — into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

The same technology that powers Bidgely's customer suite also enables a set of powerful grid applications. From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is accelerating utility innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, load forecasting, grid analytics, and rate designs. Bidgely's UtilityAI™ energy analytics platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

How You Fit In

The Senior Technical Program Manager (STPM) owns Bidgely's largest and most technically and commercially complex utility engagements, combining the roles of technical consultant, functional consultant, and project manager. The STPM also acts as a delivery and practice leader for the broader Customer Onboarding team. The STPM works closely with a dedicated delivery team on the technical build, with R&D and Product Management on platform direction, and with Systems Integrator partners on multi-party engagements — while owning the customer relationship, executive stakeholder management, and program outcomes. The STPM reports into the Director, Customer Onboarding and is part of Bidgely's Customer Onboarding team.

Core responsibilities span the following areas:

Project Management

Be the face of Bidgely for the customer during the implementation phase, owning the relationship, and being an advocate for them internally
Manage Bidgely's largest and most complex utility implementations end to end from Onboarding to Launch, leading cross-functional teams across Delivery, Engineering, Product, and Sales
Oversee project financials — including cost tracking, budget, and margin — for assigned engagements
Contribute to contract reviews for new deals and change orders
Represent the Onboarding team in sales presentations as needed
Develop and apply a deep understanding of energy markets and customer behaviors to help Bidgely customers take full advantage of the technology

Technology Implementation

Own the overall solution design and development for Bidgely's most complex utility customers, working with our global engineering team — including requirement analysis, customer journey scope discussion, data integration, design, solution architecture, implementation, delivery, and customer-facing technical issue resolution
Be the product expert who collaborates with utility customers to understand requirements, map them to product features, and finalize product customizations and changes
Manage project deliverables, ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery through a hands-on approach
Produce technical and product documents that clearly define customer requirements and solution design in collaboration with the customer's IT and business teams
Partner with Bidgely R&D and Product Management to design new platform functionality and implementation tooling, informed by patterns observed across the most complex customer implementations

Practice Leadership

Mentor and provide delivery and technical guidance to colleagues
Own executive-level customer relationships for high-visibility engagements
Develop proposals and statements of work for new and expanding engagements
Identify and help scope account expansion opportunities during delivery
Represent Customer Onboarding in quarterly business reviews (QBRs)
Work with Systems Integrator (SI) partners to plan and execute complex, multi-party implementations
Train Bidgely, SI, and customer teams on Bidgely's project methodology and product capabilities
Develop internal tools and processes that improve delivery quality and reduce implementation timelines
Support hiring and interviewing for the broader TPM team

Skills And Qualifications

Required Qualifications

7-11 years of software integration project experience at a SaaS company, or experience in a top-tier systems integration consulting firm and/or delivering enterprise solutions at a fast-paced start-up
Track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional implementations for large, high-touch enterprise customers, ideally with ACV of $500K+
Experience as the primary point of contact for enterprise customers, including designing and deploying solution architecture in a customer-facing role
Experience working with globally dispersed customers and teams
Experience with Agile software development methodologies and cloud-based B2B implementations
Comfortable creating and tracking project plans, risks, and status reports via Wrike, Smartsheets, Jira, or similar cloud project management tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to translate complex technical issues for non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop less experienced team members
Highly organized, collaborative, and proactive, with a customer-first mentality

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of SQL, Python, REST APIs, or data transformation tools, with a hands-on aptitude for applying them directly
Passion for or experience within the energy or energy efficiency sector
PMP certification

What You Get

Growth Potential: Build your career at a fast-scaling company at the forefront of AI-driven energy innovation
Collaborative Environment: Work with a passionate team united by the goal of a clean energy future
Leading Technology: Gain hands-on exposure to the AI, machine learning, and data platforms shaping the future of the utility industry

Salary And Compensation

The base salary ranges from $135,000-$160,000 DOE. This role may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and equity, subject to company policy and role level.

In accordance with the California Equal Pay and Pay Transparency laws, the approximate annual base compensation range is listed above. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be determined by a number of factors including the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Program Manager, Academics supports the implementation and continuous improvement of K12's portfolio-wide academic strategy. Working closely with the Director, Academic Strategy, this role translates strategic priorities into effective processes, tools, resources, communications, and supports that help schools strengthen academic practice and student outcomes.

The Program Manager plays a key role in managing the K12 School Playbook process, analyzing implementation and performance information, identifying trends and effective practices across schools, and supporting the development and adoption of scalable academic solutions. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong academic knowledge, analytical thinking, project management, and the ability to coordinate complex work across teams and schools.

Essential Functions:
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

Support implementation of K12's academic strategy by translating priorities into plans, processes, tools, resources, and school-facing supports.
Manage key components of the annual K12 School Playbook process, including timelines, templates, guidance, communications, review workflows, documentation, and follow-up.
Support review of school Playbooks to promote quality, coherence, and alignment with K12 expectations.
Coordinate the Playbook review and feedback process, track required revisions and emerging themes, and support consistent application of established quality standards.
Analyze Playbooks, implementation evidence, academic performance, engagement, graduation, and accountability data to identify common strengths, challenges, and opportunities across schools.
Synthesize findings across schools and help identify, document, and share effective and evidence-informed practices that can be scaled across the portfolio.
Develop and maintain academic frameworks, implementation guides, tools, exemplars, resources, and other materials that support strong Tier 1 academic practices and consistent execution.
Support implementation and monitoring of academic initiatives, identify implementation barriers, and recommend adjustments based on data and school feedback.
Partner with school and portfolio leaders to gather feedback, understand implementation needs, and support effective adoption of academic priorities and practices.
Develop and coordinate professional learning, communications, and resources related to academic strategy, the School Playbook, and priority academic practices.
Manage project plans, timelines, deliverables, documentation, and cross-functional coordination for assigned academic initiatives.
Collaborate with Accountability, Assessment, Research, Curriculum and Instruction, School Services, Transformation, Special Programs, School Counseling, Career Readiness, and other teams to support aligned implementation.
Prepare analyses, summaries, presentations, and recommendations for the Director, Academic Strategy and other leaders related to academic performance, Playbook implementation, emerging trends, and strategic initiatives.
Support continuous improvement by monitoring implementation and outcomes, gathering stakeholder feedback, and recommending improvements to academic processes, tools, and supports.

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Five (5) or more years of related experience in K–12 education, instructional leadership, academic programs, school support, project or program management, or a related field; OR

Demonstrated experience coordinating complex projects or initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
Experience using academic or student performance data to identify trends and support decision-making.

Strong understanding of effective K–12 instructional practices and systems supporting student academic success.
Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative information, identify patterns, and translate findings into clear recommendations and resources.
Strong project and program management skills, including managing timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and multiple priorities.
Demonstrated ability to develop clear, practical tools, guidance, resources, and communications for school or instructional audiences.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain quality and consistency across complex processes and deliverables.
Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and organizational levels and influence without direct authority.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
Strong organizational skills, initiative, and results orientation in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Desired Qualifications

Master's degree in education, curriculum and instruction, educational leadership, or a related field.
Experience as a teacher, instructional coach, school leader, or district/network academic staff member.
Experience in virtual education.
Experience supporting schools across multiple locations or states.
Experience with school academic planning, instructional frameworks, continuous improvement processes, or implementation monitoring.
Knowledge of state accountability systems, academic performance measures, assessment, MTSS, and graduation outcomes.

This position will oversee the day-to-day operations, set program objectives and roadmaps, manage risks and budgets, evaluate processes for continuous improvement, and cultivate new business opportunities with existing and potential clients. Lead, direct, and develop a geographically dispersed team of project managers and front-line leaders including recruitment, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and professional development planning.
Set clear expectations, provide strategic coaching, actionable feedback, and conduct performance reviews to build capability and succession planning.
Measure training effectiveness and business outcomes (time-to-competency, certification pass rates, first-time fix rate, warranty spend, customer satisfaction) and iterate programs based on data.
