Manage program risks and opportunities
Full P&L responsibilities for assigned programs

Collaborate with and support business development and marketing teams in key pursuits.

Regular travel to customer sites: Domestic 20% International 5%

Experience with diagnostic scan tools, oscilloscopes, data recorders, and recalibration tools.

BS/BA Business Management or equivalent work experience

Millennium Space Systems, a part of Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS), is a fast, agile small satellite company focused on national security space. Our missions have direct impact to global security, like missile warning and Earth observation.

Our team is curious, bold and innovative. We take risks, innovate and explore new techniques and technologies. We influence change because we challenge the status quo. And when we watch our satellites launch, we know each one of us made it happen.

This position is responsible for creating a secure environment to facilitate the successful development and execution of classified programs at the assigned organization where classified information is stored, accessed, or where accessed personnel are assigned.

The Industrial Security Manager will enforce strict adherence to applicable laws as well as national DoD, and other security policies and requirements. Coordination of classified matters with the respective government representatives will be at the forefront of their responsibilities. The Industrial Security Specialist will be charged with the establishment of quality training for assigned accessed personnel and conduct and document annual compliance inspections and develop Corrective Action Plans (CAP). This is an onsite role in our office in El Segundo, CA.

Oversee successful support of staff assisted visits, security reviews and inspections as well as conducting initial, recurring and refresher security education training

ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY’s solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies.

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today’s data-rich world.

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy.

Job Description

The ePMO Strategy & Intelligence Analyst supports the translation of enterprise strategy into measurable operational goals, performance insights, and cross-functional initiatives across Delivery.

This role works at an enterprise level, partnering with leadership to understand strategic priorities, define the operational objectives required to support those priorities, and evaluate whether projects, programs, resources, and performance are aligned with the organization’s long-term direction.

The analyst combines strategic planning, business intelligence, project management knowledge, and executive communication to connect organizational vision with measurable execution. This individual independently leads complex initiatives, analyzes enterprise performance, identifies risks and gaps, and provides clear recommendations that support informed decision-making.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Enterprise Strategy & Performance

Translate enterprise strategy into measurable operational goals, KPIs, and initiatives.
Evaluate project, program, financial, and operational performance against enterprise priorities.
Identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities that may affect strategic outcomes.
Recommend priorities and actions based on enterprise value, risk, financial impact, and strategic alignment.
Maintain an enterprise-wide perspective across business lines and functions.

Business Intelligence & Analytics

Analyze portfolio, operational, financial, and performance data to identify trends and support decision-making.
Develop data models, SQL queries, dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting.
Perform trend, variance, gap, impact, and scenario analysis.
Connect operational performance to strategic goals and business outcomes.
Translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership.

Enterprise Planning & Program Leadership

Partner with leaders to define operational goals, success measures, milestones, and execution plans that support strategic priorities.
Independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from planning through implementation and outcome validation.
Coordinate stakeholders, dependencies, risks, and decisions across multiple business areas.
Maintain initiative momentum and accountability with limited day-to-day oversight.
Identify barriers early and escalate when executive direction or prioritization is required.

Enterprise Work Management Strategy

Define how strategic goals, enterprise initiatives, and measurable outcomes should connect across the organization’s work-management framework
Use Asana and other enterprise data sources to evaluate alignment between strategic priorities, active initiatives, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
Identify gaps in enterprise visibility that limit leadership’s ability to measure progress, understand risk, or make informed decisions.
Establish business and analytical requirements needed to improve strategic planning, portfolio visibility, and performance measurement.
Recommend enterprise-level approaches for connecting goals, initiatives, milestones, and performance indicators across business lines.
Evaluate whether the organization’s work-management practices provide sufficient information to support strategic decision-making and executive reporting.

Executive Decision Support

Prepare concise executive recommendations that communicate performance, strategic impact, risks, financial or resource considerations, options, and decisions required.
Translate complex operational and analytical findings into clear business narratives.
Model scenarios and evaluate alternative approaches to support leadership decisions.
Present objective, data-supported recommendations and appropriately challenge assumptions

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.

We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. About The Position

Responsible to manage one large project or multiple technology projects of varying sizes and complexities from start to finish, including estimating, contract negotiations, project design, technical direction, quality control, job scheduling, financial oversight, problem resolution, job completion, coordination, communication, client satisfaction activities and other related duties. This position manages a team of project management employees and has responsibility for business development, project budgets, projections and contracts, job solicitation and project negotiations, in alignment with all Company policies, procedures, key objectives and regulations.This position may assist technologies construction projects including but not limited to all types of low voltage systems such as voice/data, video and security systems, audiovisual, nurse call, distributed antenna systems, and fire alarm systems.

Our Ideal Candidate

Puts a strong emphasis on candidate experience.
Can flex and adapt with the growing needs of the business.
Has extensive experience managing technology construction projects.
Can adhere to the travel nature of the role.

Day in the Life

Partners with leadership to provide strategic input to key objectives and decisions affecting the business unit and functional work group. Conducts high-quality business development and job solicitation in the marketplace, in partnership with other Company leaders. Provides ongoing quality reviews and project communication with owners, contractors, designers, subcontractors, engineers, architects, field staff, and other customers or stakeholders, addressing and resolving issues when needed.
Directs all phases and activities of each project to achieve high quality and productivity in the work performed. This includes bidding, budgeting, monitoring projections, and establishing goals and standards of performance. Ensures all jobs or contracts are fulfilled to the customer’s satisfaction, and the Company earns a fair profit. Ensures all plans and submittals are thoroughly and accurately reviewed for content and conformance with the construction documents and maintained in the appropriate systems.
others to transfer documentation, schedules, and other information.
Provides day-to-day direction to project foreman and/or superintendent to monitor productivity goals and build teamwork. Partners with appropriate personnel to conduct job site inspections and ensure accurate scope, placement, and conformance with the contract documents and the Company’s project quality assurance standards. Ensures all field personnel have the current materials, tools, plans, schedules, and directions needed for work, and that all changes in budget and scope of work are communicated and documented appropriately.
Provides high-quality hiring, coaching, communications, training, mentoring, and team building to staff and other co-workers as needed. Provides performance feedback regularly. Addresses people's issues as they arise and involves the necessary resources to resolve problems.
Creates and manages an annual financial budget and maintains some level of responsibility for Companywide financials. Stays informed of new and changing Company procedures, policies, materials, technologies, techniques, and practices. Establishes, trains, and maintains policies and processes as needed.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in electrical, project management, construction management, or a related field.

Strong business analysis and mathematical skills. Excellent communicator/collaborator, with the ability to clearly and concisely articulate ideas and concepts and the ability to build strong working teams, cultures, and relationships at all levels and with customers, subcontractors, vendors, and other community leaders. Strong business development, documentation, and report preparation skills.
Strong hiring, collaboration, teamwork, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work with and facilitate diverse work teams. Leadership, customer focus, delegation, and decision-making skills. Working knowledge of collective bargaining agreements.

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

People Operations is taking on more complex, cross-functional program work as Harvey grows globally — from opening new entities and markets, to integrating acquisitions, to evolving the systems and providers that support our employees around the world. These programs span People, Finance, Legal, Tax, IT, and other teams, and need a dedicated owner who can bring the whole thing together.

You’ll run point on these initiatives end-to-end: defining requirements, building the plan, driving decisions and execution across teams, and making sure we’re ready to go live. This is a hands-on program management role — you’ll work closely with functional experts, but you’re expected to get into the substance, develop a point of view, and personally execute work wherever needed to drive the program forward.

What You'll Do

Own complex global programs from scope through go-live and handoff, including new entity formation and geographic expansion, M&A integrations, and the ongoing evolution of our infrastructure in existing markets — such as EOR and vendor transitions, payroll migrations, and other major operational changes.
Build and drive the program plan, translating a messy objective into clear requirements, workstreams, owners, dependencies, readiness gates, and decisions; proactively surface risks, resolve blockers, and adjust the plan as facts change.
Connect the dots across functions. Partner deeply with People Ops, People Systems, Finance, Payroll, Legal, Tax, IT, and other teams to understand how decisions in one workstream affect another and make sure nothing falls between the cracks.
Own program communication and change management, from crisp executive updates and decision points to clear, thoughtful communications for employees affected by a change.
Build repeatable infrastructure as we scale, turning what we learn from each program into better templates, SOPs, playbooks, and operating processes for the next one.
Keep the employee experience at the center. Make sure operational complexity behind the scenes translates into a coordinated, thoughtful experience for employees — particularly during high-change moments like entering a new market, transitioning employment infrastructure, or integrating an acquired team.

7+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs, with experience in global People infrastructure such as geographic expansion, entity formation, M&A integration, or related work.

Work closely with onsite team, offshore team, managers and executives to ensure the release of high quality solutions

The company is America’s fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, the product provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, the organization prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project.

Traits of a Team Member

If you’ve been called scrappy, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just fit in. You’re a team player who’s self-motivated and action-oriented. You’re committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You’re a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you’ll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You’re hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then the team wants to meet you.

What You Will Do

The Associate, Project Manager will support the planning, execution, and adoption of strategic digital transformation initiatives, including AI-driven capabilities, new software platforms, and process automation tools. Working under the direction of the Program Manager, this role assists across project coordination, change management, and training to help ensure seamless integration and lasting adoption across the organization.

You will help intake and organize digital transformation requests from functions across the organization and support the coordination of initiatives from concept through delivery. As a member of the Digital Transformation team, you will collaborate closely with these partners to help scope, prioritize, and execute initiatives that drive efficiency, enable data-driven decision-making, and support long-term innovation. This role offers a strong foundation for growing into broader program leadership, with increasing responsibility over time.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Management

Support People Ops in embedding digital capabilities into onboarding and development programs.
Technology Integration
Coordinate with IT, Systems, BI, AI & Automation, and external vendors to support system integrations, tool deployments, and platform upgrades.
Help ensure smooth handover from project teams to operational owners, including documentation and support materials.
Track post-launch performance and user feedback to support continuous improvement.
Performance Tracking & Reporting
Help track KPIs and success metrics that measure adoption, efficiency gains, and business impact.
Prepare regular reports and dashboards for leadership and stakeholders.
Compile and organize data to support prioritization and future roadmap planning.
Governance & Standards
Support program governance processes, including intake, prioritization, and decision tracking.
Help ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and enterprise architecture standards.
Maintain alignment with the broader digital transformation strategy and enterprise goals.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or related field; CAPM, Agile, or Prosci certification is a plus.
3 – 5 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a related role; internship or rotational experience considered.
Familiarity with change management principles and training concepts.
Exposure to AI tools, SaaS platforms, and process automation technologies.
Experience using project management software to organize work, track progress, and manage cross-functional tasks; Monday.com experience is a plus.
Strong communication, organizational, and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail.

jobs.title: Research Operations Program Manager | Remote (US, EST/CST Time Zone)
jobs.description:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform
in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B
company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Research Operations Program Manager
to help build and scale our research recruitment operations at Maze.

In this role, you’ll work with prospects, customers, and partners to help our users recruit the right participants for their studies. You’ll sit at the center of our research
participant marketplace
, where customers come to Maze with recruitment needs and we fulfill them through our network of panel partners.

You’ll play an important role in delivering a great experience for our customers while helping shape the processes, tools, and strategy behind our growing recruitment business.

As a Research Operations Manager at Maze, you will:

Own relationships with our panel vendors, assessing performance across quality and fulfillment to determine how we prioritize and route orders.
Onboard new panel vendors based on business needs, including running due diligence to ensure quality and compatibility.
Review and interpret customer recruitment requirements and assess feasibility.
Place and manage orders across our network of panel vendors.
Monitor order progress and fulfillment, proactively identifying and flagging issues or delays.
Troubleshoot common fulfillment challenges, including low incidence rates and screener drop-off, and escalate when needed.
Build end-to-end processes that improve the efficiency and scalability of our operating model.
Partner with Product and Engineering to help shape and build the internal tools that support our operations.
Bring operational insights into decisions around our product roadmap and pricing.
Develop customer-facing materials that make our recruitment offering easy to understand and use.
Take on additional areas of ownership as the business grows, based on your strengths and interests.

You should apply if:

You have 3+ years of experience in operations, consulting, research operations, UX research, or market research.
You’ve worked in fast paced, ambiguous environments and have experience taking projects from strategy through implementation.
You’re scrappy and resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out as you go.
You have strong attention to detail and can manage multiple moving pieces without losing sight of the customer experience.
You’re a strong collaborator who can work effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders and keep projects moving forward.
You’re an exceptional communicator who can deliver recommendations clearly and concisely to customers.
You’re comfortable presenting to both technical and executive audiences, whether through presentations, demos, or more informal discussions.
You’re a high-energy team player with a strong track record of building collaborative relationships across an organization.

Nice to have:

Experience working at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
Experience in Market Research or UX Research.
Experience working in a remote environment.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.
Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.
Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid
For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources
Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid
Flexible time off
Meaningful equity
Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze
New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze
Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents
$500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage
If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

$1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space
Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours
Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more
Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year
SWAG, we have some really cool swag
Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here.

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn
for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application
, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, the company helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

The company's security organization sits at the intersection of proactive, long-term initiatives and reactive, business-critical work. As the organization has grown, managing that balance, anticipating the downstream impact of changing priorities, and giving leadership a clear view of security risk and exposure have become increasingly important, and increasingly complex.

This role is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to bring structure and visibility to this space.

The individual will operate horizontally across the security organization, partnering with Product Security, Cyber Resiliency, and Governance & Trust. While they will be closely embedded with those teams in their day-to-day work, they will also help coordinate priorities, dependencies, and execution across the broader security organization.

The impact of this role will extend well beyond security. Because security intersects with nearly every function at the company — including engineering, product, legal, finance, sales, and marketing — the individual will build the systems, processes, and relationships that enable effective collaboration across the company.

This is a senior, strategic role with substantial room to grow. The individual will not inherit a fully defined playbook; they will help create it. They will establish the processes, dashboards, and prioritization mechanisms that give the security organization greater clarity and leverage, and over time, expand that impact into broader company-wide programs and operating processes.

Key Responsibilities

Own workflow, project tracking, and dependency management across the three security teams, making it clear what’s on track, what’s at risk, and what downstream impact changes may have.
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that give company leadership a clear, durable view of security risk, exposure, and program health.
Partner closely with the primary security team on day-to-day execution while supporting the other two teams as priorities and capacity allow.
Make and communicate prioritization decisions when demand exceeds the security organization’s capacity — including finding alternatives and helping stakeholders understand trade-offs, rather than simply saying no.
Design and implement lightweight processes that help security teams operate more effectively without creating unnecessary overhead for engineers.
Work directly with product, engineering, and other partner teams to establish clear, effective ways of working with security.
As the role grows, extend impact beyond security by helping shape broader company processes, including how the organization approaches planning, prioritization, and cross-functional execution.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or operations roles
Meaningful experience in a broad, cross-functional operations or program management role, supporting many stakeholders across an organization rather than working within a single, self-contained team.
Security experience is a plus, but not required. More important is the ability to operate effectively in a horizontal role with a large and diverse stakeholder group.
A track record of building processes and exercising sound judgment in ambiguous environments, rather than defaulting to standard frameworks or playbooks.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to act as a strategic and consultative partner across functions.
Experience managing competing priorities and communicating trade-offs, including difficult prioritization decisions, clearly and thoughtfully.
Comfort working in a fast-moving, scaling environment where processes are still being built and refined.

Additional Information

Security work at the company doesn’t follow a predictable schedule. Proactive initiatives and reactive, business-critical needs are constantly competing for the same time and attention. This role exists to bring structure to that tension — helping the security organization make deliberate choices about where to focus and how to respond when priorities inevitably shift.

At the same time, company leadership needs a clearer, more consistent view of the security posture, risk, and exposure than there is currently a dedicated mechanism to provide. The individual will build that reporting infrastructure and make it durable as the organization grows.

And because security intersects with nearly every part of the business, there will be an unusually broad view of how the company operates. Over time, there will be the opportunity to take what is learned in security and apply it to larger, org-wide programs and processes — helping shape not just how security works, but how the company works as a whole.

Base Salary Range

$153,000—$180,000 USD

About Us

The organization lives and breathes its company values:

jobs.description:
Bold Thinking. World Changing.
At SkyWater, our ingenuity helps improve lives around the world by manufacturing U.S. made semiconductors that are essential ingredients of modern life. We manufacture products for aerospace and defense, medical, automotive, consumer and industrial markets, to name a few. Step into the future.
SkyWater’s values of Integrity, Excellence, Collaboration, Empowerment and Growth Mindset guide us to cultivate an empowered, learning environment. We also invest in developing highly skilled, dedicated employees — and employees who are entering the workforce for the first time, from the military, and a variety of educational backgrounds.

Are you bold thinking?
Find your place on our team and help us change the world!

Position Summary:
The Senior Program Manager, Quantum Foundry Customer Assurance owns and leads the day-to-day delivery of SkyWater’s Quantum Foundry Customer Assurance Program. Reporting to the Director, Compliance & Ethics, this role has full programmatic accountability for the development, implementation, oversight, and continuous improvement of the company’s program to protect quantum customer confidential information, manage appropriate access and personnel safeguards, and support consistent execution of customer commitments across the quantum foundry business. This role serves as the company’s subject matter expert on program administration and partners closely with Legal and business partners to align the program with customer commitments, applicable laws (including antitrust laws), and internal policies. The Senior Program Manager exercises independent judgment across key areas and serves employees across SkyWater’s Minnesota, Texas, and Florida operations. The Senior Manager partners closely with the Director to ensure the program is well-designed, effectively implemented, and supports SkyWater’s ability to remain a trusted multi-customer quantum foundry.

Responsibilities

Quantum Foundry Customer Assurance Program Management

Develop and maintain program policies, procedures, and guidance documents. Collaborate with cross functional partners to drive execution, implementation and adherence to such policies.
Establish and manage governance structures, including any necessary steering committees and working groups, and serve as the senior functional authority on program matters escalated from across the business. Ensure escalations are risk reviewed, cataloged, and elevated to the Director as necessary to appropriately govern the program.
Coordinate implementation and monitoring of program requirements across business functions, including customer information safeguards, system access, personnel assignments, and consistent application of customer commitments and service-level practices, taking into account contractual terms, paid service levels, technical requirements, and business priorities.
Implement, own, and advance a mature, well-documented program that is risk-based, operationally effective, and defensible to customers and external stakeholders.
Develop and maintain program dashboards, key performance indicators and any required reporting, including reporting to the Director, executive leadership, and external parties as appropriate.
Lead program activities. Create a repository of program requirements and an inventory control framework to track activities.
Administer information safeguards and access-control requirements, including tracking non-disclosure agreements, system access, information flows, roster status, and employee assignments by customer; support personnel changes and serve as the primary operational point of contact for program requirements and inquiries.

Training & Communications

Design, develop, and coordinate delivery of training on program requirements, customer confidential information, service commitments, and relevant antitrust considerations across functions, roles, and risk levels; evaluate training effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
Lead the design and execution of awareness campaigns and communications, including support for customer-facing materials describing SkyWater’s safeguards and program commitments; tailor messaging by audience and risk exposure; maintain records of training delivery and completion to support internal oversight, customer assurance, and audit or regulatory needs.

Risk Assessment & Monitoring

Lead periodic program risk assessments, exercising senior-level judgment to prioritize risks and translate findings into program enhancements.
Develop monitoring and testing activities to assess program effectiveness across the organization.
Analyze trends and recommend enhancements to controls and program processes based on risk assessments, monitoring and/or testing activities.
Serve as a primary point of contact for internal or external reviews related to the program, including direct engagement with regulatory representatives as appropriate.

Remediation & Continuous Improvement

Track remediations activities and corrective action plans for any program findings.
Lead mitigation of such findings with necessary cross functional partners and drive escalations as necessary.

Investigations & Incident Management

Lead or co-lead reviews or investigations involving potential program, customer information protection, or antitrust concerns, exercising independent judgment on scoping, interviewing, analysis, and conclusions.
Coordinate with Legal, HR, and Compliance & Ethics teams on review strategy, privilege considerations, and remediation; manage cross-functional coordination as the senior program lead on matter response.
Ensure timely escalation of program issues through appropriate channels, including SkyWater’s Speak Up Program as appropriate, and share with the Director, Compliance & Ethics.
Partner with the Director of Compliance and Ethics to ensure employees understand program expectations, how to raise concerns, and applicable non-retaliation principles through targeted communications, manager enablement, and employee engagement initiatives across all company locations.

Culture & Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as the primary on-the-ground program point of contact for employees across SkyWater’s Minnesota, Florida, and Texas sites; take responsibility for the employee-facing program presence and foster trust and confidence in the Quantum Foundry Customer Assurance Program.
Build effective partnerships with HR, Legal, Operations, Finance, Security, IT, and other functions to embed customer protection and program practices into business processes and decision-making.

This position also requires performing other duties as assigned. Percentages of time spent on job duties are estimates and may vary for each position.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required; degree in business, law, criminal justice, organizational management, or a related field preferred.
7-10 years of progressively responsible experience in ethics and compliance, program management, internal investigations, legal, risk, or a related field, including demonstrated experience owning and leading defined program areas or functions.
Experience designing, implementing, and managing enterprise programs involving cross-functional controls, governance, or risk management.
Proven ability to influence senior leaders and business partners without direct authority.
Experience developing policies, standards, procedures, and controls to effectively manage a cross-functional program.
Strong project and program management experience, including leading cross functional initiatives. Ability to make connections across program elements to drive sustainable programs.
Ability to utilize metrics and data to create reporting, dashboards and automated solutions where appropriate.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and tactfully with employees at all levels of the organization.

The annual salary range for this role is $134,080-$201,120. Pay offered is based on many factors. including but not limited to, the job-related experience, skills, education, and credentials of each candidate.

SkyWater offers an exciting environment where the brightest semiconductor minds come together to achieve exceptional results. We offer competitive salary and an opportunity to participate in incentive plans as well as other employee financial benefits, including 401k match, and life insurance.

Additionally, SkyWater offers a comprehensive benefits package which promotes a healthy life. This includes benefit eligibility day one, medical, dental, mental health benefits, vision, legal planning, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid holidays, an on-site fitness facility, and an on-site self-serve market.

You will run all of this inside Mariana’s Capital Project OS, the software tools that automate and standardize how we plan, track, and execute programs. You will ensure standardization in execution approaches in the program and provide feedback on Capital Project OS to the software and product management teams to continuously improve the tool.

What You’ll Do

Own end-to-end delivery of an assigned capital program—scope, schedule, budget, and risk—from development through construction and handover to operations
Build and maintain the integrated program schedule, tracking critical path, interdependencies, long-lead items, and resource needs
Own the program budget and cost forecast, partnering with project controls and finance on estimates, commitments, variances, and change control
Manage interfaces across process development, process engineering, detailed engineering, procurement, construction, business development, and finance so decisions move quickly and nothing falls between disciplines
Run the program cadence and checkpoints. Execution planning, design reviews, status meetings, and readiness gates
Surface risks and open decisions early, quantify their schedule and cost impact, drive them to closure, and escalate with a recommendations
Produce program reporting and dashboards that give leadership a view of status, critical path, risks, and trade-offs
Manage engineering partners, vendors, and contractors against scope, deliverable schedules, and quality expectations
Run your program inside Mariana’s Capital Project OS, drive consistent adoption across your workstreams, and feed requirements, gaps, and improvement ideas back to the software team
Support construction, commissioning, and startup in the field, and contribute to Mariana’s program-management standards, templates, and metrics as the portfolio grows

Desired Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field
4+ years of program or project management experience on capital projects in mining, minerals processing, chemical, energy, or heavy-industrial environments
Demonstrated ownership of an integrated schedule and budget on a project spanning multiple engineering disciplines and external partners
Strong technical fluency—able to read P&IDs, general arrangements, and equipment lists
Excellent written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills,
Willingness to travel to project sites as programs require

Everyone Gets Home Safe.

Extreme Ownership.
We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate.
We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos.
We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.

Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

jobs.description:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

Rivian is seeking a highly organized and results-oriented Technical Program Manager to drive the successful execution of complex, high-impact programs, typically exceeding $50M. In this role, you will be instrumental in defining, maintaining, and delivering program scope, schedule, and budget, ensuring alignment across cross-functional teams and external partners. You will foster strong working relationships, proactively manage risks, and establish clear communication channels to ensure program success and contribute to Rivian's mission of redefining sustainable transportation and energy. This role is located at our Normal, IL/Plymouth, MI or Atlanta, GA facility and reports directly to a Director, Manufacturing Engineering.

Responsibilities

Program Management: Own and develop comprehensive program plans, including scope definition and maintenance, detailed schedules with critical milestones and gates (looking 1-3 years out for new product launches), and robust budget and resource planning for programs >$50M. Regularly report on program status, demonstrating measured success in schedule, budget, and scope delivery.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Partnerships: Cultivate strong partnerships with internal engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and other relevant teams, as well as external vendors and suppliers. Proactively identify and document the needs and outputs of cross-functional teams to ensure seamless collaboration. Represent Rivian effectively in interactions with external partners, demonstrating autonomy and driving program success.
Team Collaboration & Influence: Foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment, becoming a recognized leader and a vital part of the working team. Facilitate smooth interactions and effectively manage interpersonal dynamics to minimize disruptions. While working independently of people managers, you will often guide working teams to prioritize and focus on critical tasks and projects, leveraging the manufacturing plan of record to set expectations with cross-functional partners.
Risk Management & Mitigation: Identify, document, and manage risks at the program level, developing and implementing mitigation strategies to ensure on-time and within-budget delivery.
Program Planning & Execution: Create and maintain detailed program plans for new product launches with a 1-3 year horizon, clearly outlining critical milestones and gates.
Organizational Tools & Communication: Establish and manage systems for action tracking (e.g., JIRA) and documentation (e.g., ACC, Google Drive) from the ground up. Develop and deliver clear and concise program status reports on a regular basis, ensuring accuracy and requiring minimal correction. Align the team around consistent methods of organization and communication.
Agility & Problem Solving: Take ambiguous goals and translate them into specific, actionable tasks for firefighting and burn-down activities, assisting technical leads in prioritizing competing projects. Proactively identify areas where cross-functional support is needed and effectively leverage partnerships to secure the necessary resources for issue resolution.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field.
7+ years' experience managing complex programs with budgets exceeding $50M, demonstrating successful delivery within scope, schedule, and budget.
Strong skills in defining and maintaining program/project scope throughout the project lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to build strong working relationships and partnerships with both internal and external teams.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Experience working effectively with external vendors and suppliers.
Ability to work independently and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
Experience setting up and utilizing program management tools for task tracking and documentation (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, or similar).
Strong organizational skills and the ability to align teams around common processes and communication methods.
Proven ability to take vague goals and develop specific action plans to address immediate challenges.
Experience identifying and escalating cross-functional dependencies and resource needs.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the automotive or manufacturing industry.
Familiarity with new product introduction (NPI) processes.
Experience with risk management methodologies and tools.

The salary range for this role is $140,600-$175,800 for Illinois, Michigan or Georgia based applicants . This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than 10/1/2026.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As part of a hardworking team of engineering professionals, you will use your technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. A passion for our mission and vision is required. If you're excited about providing near-term value, solving novel problems, learning about interesting topics, and taking on challenging work, we encourage you to apply.

This role reports to the RF Systems Group within the Lunar Permanence business unit. As part of a growing, hardworking, and curious team of design engineers, you'll work directly with NASA and our National Team Partners on the Human Landing System (HLS) Sustaining Lunar Development (SLD) program. You will play a key role in developing the Lunar Permanence system that will return humans to the Moon and extend human presence permanently beyond Earth.

Special Mentions

Relocation provided
Travel up to 10% of the time
Interviews will include a technical assessment

jobs.title: Strategic Workforce Planning Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Strategic Workforce Planning Program Manager supports the launch and ongoing execution of the Strategic Workforce Planning function. This role manages key workstreams related to program planning, tools, resources, training, communications, and cross-functional coordination. Working with HR business partners, Workforce Intelligence, Finance, and local subject matter experts, this role helps define business requirements, support tool and vendor evaluations, coordinate pilots, and drive adoption of workforce planning processes and resources. The role also helps translate workforce insights into clear business implications, decision options, and recommended next steps. This is a highly collaborative role suited for someone who is comfortable building structure in a developing function and translating ambiguity into organized plans, routines, and deliverables.

Key Job Responsibilities

Program & Workstream Management

Build and maintain integrated project plans, timelines, dependencies, and milestone tracking across Strategic Workforce Planning workstreams.
Help establish and maintain the operating cadence for the Strategic Workforce Planning function, including recuring planning routines, governance checkpoints, and status updates.
Manage routine program governance deliverables, including action tracking, decision logs, and concise stakeholder updates.
Prepare decision materials that summarize options, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and recommended next steps.
Facilitate working sessions, capture decisions, drive follow-ups, and escalate issues as needed.

Tool Planning & Vendor Evaluation Support

Partner with Workforce Intelligence to support Strategic Workforce Planning tool evaluations, including criteria, scorecards, and demo materials tied to business use cases.
Coordinate vendor touchpoints, including scheduling, agendas, materials, notes, and comparison summaries.
Document workforce planning options and tradeoffs, including implementation considerations, risks, dependencies, and time-to-value.

Requirements & Implementation Planning

Partner with Strategic Workforce Planning Analysts and Workforce Intelligence to define business requirements for dashboards, datasets, and workflow needs.
Support implementation planning, including scope, resources, roadmap, training inputs, and readiness criteria.
Coordinate user acceptance testing, capture feedback, and help translate feedback into backlog items and release plans.

Enablement, Training & Communications

Support adoption and change management activities, including training calendars, office hours, pilot sessions, stakeholder communications, and feedback loops.
Support partner-facing toolkit materials, such as quick-start guides, FAQs, release notes, and how-to resources.
Establish feedback loops with HR partners and local subject matter experts to identify recurring issues and practical improvements.

Governance, Quality, and Sustainment

Support governance routines, including intake, prioritization, change control, publish readiness, and issue triage.
Track issues related to data refresh, access, or tooling, and coordinate triage and stakeholder communications with Workforce Intelligence.
Document repeatable standard work and transition operational routines as the function matures.

Job Requirements (Skills & Experience)

Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Project Management, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
3-5+ years of experience in program development, program management, HR, analytics, learning and development, or a related field.
Demonstrated program and project management capability (planning, dependency management, meeting facilitation, action tracking, status reporting).
Experience coordinating cross-functional work involving HR, analytics, technology, and/or finance partners.
Experience supporting requirements development and implementation planning.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear, partner-friendly materials and executive-ready updates.
Experience preparing concise updates, recommendations, and decision materials for leadership.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to coordinate across multiple workstreams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting dashboards, tools, and data products (requirements, testing, rollout coordination, adoption support).
Familiarity with HR data and Strategic Workforce Planning concepts (definitions, cadence schedules, data quality principles, access considerations).
Experience supporting vendor demos and evaluations (criteria development, scorecards, comparison summaries).
Familiarity with collaboration and program/project management tools (Teams/SharePoint, Planner/Project/Smartsheet, etc.).

Additional Success Factors

Operates with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and follow-through in a developing function.
Brings structure, clarity, and momentum to complex, cross-functional work.
Communicates proactively with stakeholders and helps keep workstreams aligned, organized, and moving forward.
Demonstrates sound judgment when managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs.
Continuously improves processes, tools, and routines to support effective Strategic Workforce Planning delivery.

About Southern Company

Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit www.southerncompany.com .

Southern Company invests in the well-being of its employees and their families through a comprehensive total rewards strategy that includes competitive base salary, annual incentive awards for eligible employees and health, welfare and retirement benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional/social well-being. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as an incentive program, with the amount of any bonus/awards subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan(s). A summary of the benefits offered for this position can be found here https://seo.nlx.org/southernco/pdf/SOCO-Benefits.pdf . Additional and specific details about total compensation and beneﬁts will also be provided during the hiring process.

Southern Company is an equal opportunity employer where an applicant's qualifications are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by law.

The Retirement and Benefits Solutions team is transforming how organizations manage the financial well-being of their people—delivering secure, scalable, and user-focused administration platforms that support millions of members across North America.

What You'll Do

Your week will move between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution. Here's what a typical engagement looks like:

NIST 800-53
Compliance Leadership

Technical Architecture & Implementation

You'll lead the design and validation of identity management, data flows, and API integrations. Stakeholder Management & Communication

You'll communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to executive leadership and client stakeholders regularly. You'll prepare status reports, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership. You'll facilitate executive steering committees and governance forums. You'll liaise with external auditors, cloud service providers, and regulatory bodies. Bedford | Hybrid – 1 / 2 Days Office per week

Are you an experienced Cyber Security or Information Security professional with a strong technical background combined with hands-on GRC, ISO 27001 and security audit experience?
We're looking for a Cyber Security Lead / Information Security Lead to join a growing technology business in Bedford and take broader ownership of its Information Security and Cyber Security environment.

As the Cyber Security Lead / Information Security Lead, you'll work closely with the Head of Information Security and key stakeholders across IT, Infrastructure, Development, Legal and the wider business.
You'll help maintain and continually improve the Information Security Management System (ISMS), supporting ISO 27001 certification and ensuring appropriate security policies, processes and controls remain effective.
A significant part of the position will involve GRC and security assurance, including security risk assessments, internal and external audits, customer assurance, supplier security assessments and supporting certification and compliance activities.
You'll also remain close to the technical security environment, working with technical teams across Infrastructure Security, Network Security, vulnerability management, patching, penetration testing, secure development, cloud security and incident response.
The role will also provide exposure to business continuity, disaster recovery, DPIAs, BIAs, Cyber Essentials and security awareness, giving you broad ownership across both operational and governance-focused Information Security.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can operate comfortably across both technical Cyber Security and Information Security GRC.

Your experience should include:
Information Security & GRC: ISO 27001, ISMS, security governance, risk management, policies, controls, compliance and security assurance.
Security Audits: practical involvement in internal/external security audits, evidence gathering, remediation, certification and customer/supplier assurance.
Technical Security: a strong understanding of Infrastructure Security, Network Security, vulnerabilities, patching, penetration testing, endpoints, identity/access and security controls.
Security Operations & Resilience: incident response, vulnerability remediation, business continuity, disaster recovery and security improvement.

You'll ideally have 5+ years' experience within Cyber Security, Information Security, IT Security, Security Engineering, Infrastructure Security or a related environment.

Equally, you may currently be working as a Senior Cyber Security Analyst, Senior Information Security Analyst, Information Security Consultant, Cyber Security Consultant, Technical Security Lead or Information Security Lead and be ready for greater ownership.

Technical Credibility + GRC Experience

We're not looking for a purely technical Security Engineer with limited governance or audit exposure, and equally, this isn't a purely compliance-led GRC position.
The successful candidate will be technically credible enough to engage with Infrastructure, Network and Engineering teams while having genuine hands-on experience across GRC, ISO 27001, ISMS and security audits.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Building Envelope / Façade
jobs.description:
Siber Façade Group is seeking an experienced and highly organized Project Manager to manage the delivery of building façade projects from award through design, manufacturing, installation, and project closeout.

This position requires a strong understanding of construction project management and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders across different locations and time zones. Siber's projects involve a combination of local construction activities and overseas manufacturing, requiring the Project Manager to maintain close coordination between clients, consultants, design teams, manufacturing facilities, logistics providers, subcontractors, and site teams.

The Project Manager will typically manage multiple projects concurrently and will be responsible for maintaining project schedules, budgets, procurement requirements, production milestones, installation sequencing, change management, and overall project performance.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of construction project management experience, preferably within the building envelope, glazing, window wall, curtain wall, cladding, or related façade industry.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery

Manage multiple façade projects simultaneously from contract award through design, procurement, manufacturing, installation, deficiency completion, and final closeout.
Develop and maintain overall project schedules, identifying key milestones, dependencies, critical-path activities, and long-lead items.
Coordinate project requirements between clients, consultants, architects, engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and internal departments.
Review project documentation, contracts, specifications, drawings, schedules, and scope requirements to ensure contractual obligations are understood and achieved.
Lead regular internal and external project meetings and ensure action items are documented, assigned, and completed.
Proactively identify project risks, schedule constraints, coordination issues, and potential cost impacts before they affect project delivery.
Maintain clear and accurate project records, correspondence, reports, meeting minutes, and project documentation.

Overseas Manufacturing & Production Coordination

Coordinate with Siber's overseas manufacturing partners and production teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage communication and coordination across multiple international time zones, including the ability to accommodate evening meetings when required.
Establish and track manufacturing schedules to ensure production aligns with construction and installation requirements.
Coordinate drawing approvals, material procurement, production releases, fabrication sequencing, quality requirements, packaging, shipping, and delivery milestones.
Monitor overseas production progress and proactively address manufacturing or supply-chain issues that could impact the project schedule.
Coordinate information between Siber's local project/design teams and overseas factories to ensure approved project requirements are accurately incorporated into production.
Work with logistics teams to coordinate international shipping, container planning, customs requirements, delivery sequencing, and site logistics.

Design & Technical Coordination

Coordinate shop drawings, engineering, samples, mock-ups, RFIs, submittals, and consultant reviews.
Work closely with Siber's internal and external design teams to maintain drawing and approval schedules.
Understand the relationship between design approvals, material procurement, manufacturing releases, shipping, and installation.
Review project drawings and specifications for constructability, scope coordination, and potential conflicts.
Coordinate façade interfaces with structure, waterproofing, membranes, cladding, doors, roofing, and adjacent building-envelope systems.
Maintain awareness of applicable performance requirements, testing requirements, and project-specific façade specifications.

Financial & Commercial Management

Establish, manage, and forecast project budgets.
Track project costs, commitments, expenditures, and projected costs to completion.
Monitor project profitability and identify potential cost overruns or financial risks.
Manage change orders, RCOs, pricing requests, back charges, and other commercial changes.
Identify and document changes in scope and ensure additional work is properly communicated and authorized.
Review subcontractor and supplier pricing, invoices, and commitments as required.
Support project billing, progress claims, schedules of values, and project financial reporting.
Ensure contractual conditions, notice requirements, and commercial obligations are maintained throughout the project.

Construction & Installation

Coordinate with site teams, installation crews, subcontractors, and general contractors to maintain installation schedules.
Plan installation sequencing based on manufacturing, shipping, building readiness, access, and overall construction schedules.
Monitor site progress and identify issues affecting productivity, quality, safety, or schedule.
Coordinate site access, material deliveries, equipment requirements, storage, hoisting, and installation logistics.
Work closely with field management to resolve construction and coordination issues.
Ensure work is completed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality requirements, and project standards.

Quality, Testing & Closeout

Coordinate with Siber's QA/QC team to ensure quality requirements are maintained throughout manufacturing and installation.
Coordinate mock-ups, field testing, water testing, inspections, and consultant reviews as required.
Manage deficiencies and ensure corrective work is completed and documented.
Coordinate project turnover documentation, warranties, closeout requirements, and final completion.
Support continuous improvement by documenting lessons learned and applying them to future projects.

Qualifications & Experience

Minimum 5 years of construction project management experience.
Experience with building envelope, glazing, window wall, curtain wall, cladding, or façade systems is strongly preferred.
Intermediate or greater understanding of window wall and curtain wall systems.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously with competing priorities and deadlines.
Experience coordinating suppliers, manufacturers, or project teams located internationally is considered a strong asset.
Strong understanding of construction drawings, specifications, contracts, schedules, and project documentation.
Demonstrated experience with project budgeting, forecasting, change management, and cost control.
Strong understanding of construction sequencing and coordination between design, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and installation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction/project-management software. Experience with platforms such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam, or similar systems is an asset.

Skills & Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

Highly organized and capable of managing numerous priorities simultaneously.
A strong communicator who can coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, trades, internal teams, and international manufacturing partners.
Comfortable working across different cultures, and time zones.
Proactive rather than reactive, with the ability to identify problems before they affect project cost or schedule.
Commercially aware and comfortable managing budgets, contracts, changes, and project risk.
Technically capable of understanding façade drawings, details, interfaces, and construction requirements.
Detail-oriented while maintaining an understanding of the overall project schedule and commercial objectives.
Comfortable making decisions and taking ownership of project outcomes.

Able to work independently while collaborating closely with Siber's design, construction, QA/QC, manufacturing, estimating, and management teams.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Project Manager at Siber Façade Group maintains control of their projects from award through completion. They understand what needs to happen next, who is responsible for it, when it needs to happen, and what the cost or schedule impact will be if it does not happen.

They maintain strong relationships with clients and project partners while ensuring Siber's design, manufacturing, logistics, and construction teams remain aligned.

Most importantly, they take ownership of their projects and proactively drive them forward rather than waiting for issues to arise.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Serval is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others.

About The Team

The Agent Deployment
team is a customer-facing technical team, central to how Serval turns product capability into real business outcomes. The org is a family of roles: Deployment Strategists are the primary technical relationship and AI advisor for each customer, partnering with Deployed Software Engineers to build enterprise-grade features and products. Deployment Success Managers own each customer's long-term success, building the systems and motions that scale adoption, expansion, and renewal well past go-live.

Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist on Serval's Agent Deployment team, you’ll be the primary technical relationship for Serval’s customers: guiding their deployments, advising their AI strategy, and owning their outcomes. You’ll work deeply within Serval’s existing product surface area: building novel workflows, configuring integrations, and shipping bug fixes and product changes yourself.

This role is for someone who thrives on execution velocity, moving quickly across multiple engagements at once. You’re at home in ambiguity and bring a strong blend of technical depth, product sense, and customer obsession. And because you sit closest to how customers actually use Serval, you'll directly shape our product roadmap: the workflows and features you build in the field make their way into the core product.

What You’ll Do

Own customer engagements from pilot through production launch: design and deliver deployments that fit each customer's workflows and scale adoption of Serval.
Build AI agents: design and build AI agents on Serval's platform that drive real value for customers.
Advise AI strategy: embed with customers to guide and shape how they adopt and scale AI.
Lead migrations: design and execute migration plans that minimize disruption and ensure seamless adoption of Serval's platform.
Partner cross-functionally: work with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to turn field learnings into repeatable processes and a sharper go-to-market.

What You’ll Need

Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
5+ years in a relevant role (product, engineering, consulting, founder).
Strong communication and relationship management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on technical ability: reading and troubleshooting production code in customer-facing environments, analyzing code paths, database state, and API requests/responses with infra and browser dev tools.
Working knowledge of APIs and REST, IAM, and SQL for data analysis.

Nice to Have

Experience in an early-stage startup environment.
Experience writing production code.
Background working with enterprise customers or complex technical sales cycles.
Familiarity with IT, security, service management, or workflow automation.

What we offer

Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.
Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.
Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

Compensation Range: £115K - £210K

Contributing to Team Success: Works cooperatively with others; is agreeable and team oriented; demonstrates a willingness to put aside personal differences for the benefit of the group as a whole
Quality Orientation: Is aware of quality issues and actively makes suggestions for improvement of product or processes; knows how personal contribution affects overall product and process quality; understands the company’s quality objectives and how they relate to the company’s objectives
Work Ethic: Maintains and promotes social, ethical, and organizational norms in conducting internal and external business activities
Continuous and Applied Learning: Actively identifies new areas for learning; regularly creates and takes advantage of learning opportunities; uses newly gained knowledge and skills on the job and leaning through their application; comprehends new job related information in a timely manner and correctly recalls and applies that information
Productivity Orientation: Takes appropriate actions to satisfy work quotas (e.g. production, assignments, projects, etc.)
